summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The WisdomTree International MidCap Dividend Fund (DIM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. The fund tracks a dividend-weighted index of dividend-paying mid-cap companies located in the developed world outside the US and Canada. DIM was launched on Jun 16, 2006 and is issued by WisdomTree.

holdings.infoBox: DIM is an equity ETF with a total of 607 individual holdings. The top holdings are AIB Group stock at 1.51%, Banca Mediolanum at 0.95%, Admiral Group at 0.85%, Wallenius Wilhelmsen ASA at 0.84%, and Tenaris at 0.80%.
